senses.en: crude and offensive in a sexual way

ex.en: The comedian was fired for making lewd comments on air.
ex.zh: 那名喜劇演員因在節目中發表下流言論而被開除。

senses.en: a person who writes or compiles dictionaries

ex.en: A lexicographer must track how the meanings of words change over time.
ex.zh: 詞典編纂者必須追蹤字義隨時間的變化。

root.note: 寫字詞（解釋）的人 → 詞典編纂者

senses.en: the practice of compiling dictionaries

ex.en: Computers have transformed modern lexicography.
ex.zh: 電腦徹底改變了現代的詞典編纂。

root.note: 書寫字詞的學問 → 詞典編纂

senses.en: the vocabulary of a person, language, or field
a dictionary, especially of an ancient language

ex.en: The word "selfie" quickly entered the English lexicon.
ex.zh: 「自拍」這個字很快就進入了英語詞彙。

senses.en: legally responsible for something
likely to do or experience something (usually bad)

ex.en: The company was held liable for the damage caused by the leak.
ex.zh: 這家公司被判須為漏油造成的損害負責。

root.note: 被（法律）綁住的 → 須負責的

senses.en: a false written statement that damages someone's reputation
to publish a false statement that damages someone's reputation

ex.en: The actor sued the magazine for libel over the false story.
ex.zh: 那名演員因不實報導控告雜誌誹謗。

root.note: 小冊子 → 散播中傷的文字 → 誹謗

mn: libel 是書面誹謗，slander 是口頭誹謗。

senses.en: a political view favoring individual rights, freedom, and gradual reform

ex.en: Classical liberalism stresses free markets and limited government.
ex.zh: 古典自由主義強調自由市場與有限政府。

senses.en: to set someone or something free

ex.en: Allied troops arrived to liberate the town after four years of occupation.
ex.zh: 盟軍在被佔領四年後抵達解放了這座城鎮。

senses.en: sexually immoral; ignoring accepted rules of behavior
senses.zh: 放蕩的；淫亂的；不守規矩的

ex.en: The king's licentious court shocked visiting diplomats.
ex.zh: 國王那放蕩的宮廷讓來訪的外交官大為震驚。

root.note: 自由過了頭 → 放蕩的

senses.en: allowed by law; legal

ex.en: Investigators found it hard to separate licit trade from smuggling.
ex.zh: 調查人員發現很難區分合法貿易和走私。

mn: 反義字 illicit（非法的）比 licit 常見得多。

senses.en: a feudal lord; also a vassal who owes loyalty to a lord
owing or entitled to feudal loyalty

ex.en: The knight knelt and swore loyalty to his liege.
ex.zh: 騎士跪下向他的君主宣誓效忠。

senses.en: a legal right to keep someone's property until a debt is paid

ex.en: The bank placed a lien on the house until the loan was repaid.
ex.zh: 在貸款還清前，銀行對這棟房子設定了留置權。

root.note: 把財產綁住 → 留置權

senses.en: place; used in the phrase "in lieu of," meaning instead of
senses.zh: 代替（用於 in lieu of）

ex.en: Workers were given extra vacation days in lieu of a raise.
ex.zh: 員工們以額外的假期代替加薪。

parts.m: place 地方（法文，源自拉丁文 locus）

mn: lieutenant（副官）= lieu（位置）+ tenant（持有者）：替長官坐位置的人。

senses.en: very similar to the real person or thing

ex.en: The wax figures in the museum look incredibly lifelike.
ex.zh: 博物館裡的蠟像看起來栩栩如生。

senses.en: lasting or continuing through a person's life

ex.en: Reading with her father gave her a lifelong love of books.
ex.zh: 和父親一起讀書讓她一輩子熱愛閱讀。

senses.en: the length of time that a person lives or a thing lasts

ex.en: Visiting Antarctica was the trip of a lifetime.
ex.zh: 去南極是一生難得的旅行。

senses.en: a tough band of tissue connecting bones at a joint

ex.en: The soccer player tore a ligament in her knee.
ex.zh: 那名足球員膝蓋的韌帶撕裂了。

root.note: 把骨頭綁在一起的東西 → 韌帶

senses.en: a thread or cord used to tie something, especially a blood vessel
two letters joined together as one character, such as æ

ex.en: The surgeon tied a ligature around the artery to stop the bleeding.
ex.zh: 外科醫生在動脈上綁了結紮線以止血。

root.note: 綁東西用的 → 結紮線

senses.en: cheerful and carefree; not serious
senses.zh: 輕鬆愉快的；無憂無慮的

ex.en: The film is a light-hearted comedy about a family road trip.
ex.zh: 這部電影是一部關於家庭公路旅行的輕鬆喜劇。

senses.en: made of or like wood; woody

ex.en: Over time, the soft stem becomes ligneous and hard.
ex.zh: 隨著時間過去，柔軟的莖會變得木質化且堅硬。

senses.en: the chance that something will happen; probability

ex.en: Regular exercise reduces the likelihood of heart disease.
ex.zh: 規律運動可降低罹患心臟病的可能性。

root.note: 可能的狀態 → 可能性

senses.en: probably going to happen or be true
probably

ex.en: It is likely to rain this afternoon, so bring an umbrella.
ex.zh: 今天下午很可能會下雨，所以帶把傘吧。

senses.en: a feeling of enjoying or being fond of something

ex.en: He has developed a liking for spicy food since moving to Sichuan.
ex.zh: 搬到四川後，他開始喜歡吃辣。

mn: 片語 to one's liking：合某人的心意。

senses.en: a rule or condition that limits something; a restriction
a weakness or lack of ability

ex.en: Every research method has at least one limitation.
ex.zh: 每種研究方法都至少有一個局限。

senses.en: arranged in or relating to a straight line
progressing from one stage to another in a single series of steps

ex.en: The story is not told in linear order but jumps back and forth in time.
ex.zh: 這個故事並非按時間順序敘述，而是在不同時間點來回跳躍。

senses.en: a large passenger ship
a layer of material inside something as a lining

ex.en: The ocean liner carried thousands of passengers across the Atlantic.
ex.zh: 那艘遠洋郵輪載著數千名旅客橫渡大西洋。

senses.en: (informal) a foreign language or the special vocabulary of a group

ex.en: It took me months to learn the tech lingo at my new job.
ex.zh: 我花了好幾個月才學會新工作裡的科技行話。

senses.en: a language used for communication between people with different native languages

ex.en: English has become the lingua franca of international science.
ex.zh: 英語已成為國際科學界的共通語言。

root.note: 原指地中海商人使用的「法蘭克語」→ 通用語

senses.en: relating to the tongue or to language

ex.en: The dentist examined the lingual surface of her lower teeth.
ex.zh: 牙醫檢查了她下排牙齒靠舌頭那一側的表面。

senses.en: a person who studies linguistics
a person skilled in foreign languages

ex.en: The linguist spent years recording the last speakers of the language.
ex.zh: 這位語言學家花了多年時間記錄該語言最後的使用者。

senses.en: the scientific study of language and its structure

ex.en: She majored in linguistics because she loved learning how languages work.
ex.zh: 她主修語言學，因為她熱愛探究語言的運作方式。

senses.en: a liquid rubbed on the skin to relieve pain or stiffness

ex.en: The coach rubbed liniment on the runner's sore calves.
ex.zh: 教練在跑者痠痛的小腿上塗抹搽劑。

root.note: 用來塗抹的東西 → 搽劑

senses.en: causing something to become liquid
a substance that causes liquefaction

ex.en: The chemist added a liquefacient agent to dissolve the thick paste.
ex.zh: 化學家加入液化劑來溶解那團濃稠的糊狀物。

senses.en: to make or become liquid

ex.en: Extreme cold can liquefy gases such as oxygen.
ex.zh: 極度低溫可以使氧氣等氣體液化。

senses.en: a strong, sweet, flavored alcoholic drink, usually taken after a meal

ex.en: The restaurant served a small glass of orange liqueur after dessert.
ex.zh: 餐廳在甜點後送上一小杯柳橙利口酒。

mn: liqueur（甜的利口酒）和 liquor（烈酒）拼法和發音都不同。

senses.en: to close a business and sell its assets to pay debts
to pay off a debt
to eliminate or kill

ex.en: The failing company was forced to liquidate its stores.
ex.zh: 那家經營不善的公司被迫清算旗下商店。

root.note: 使（帳目）清楚、變成流動現金 → 清算

senses.en: strong alcoholic drink such as whiskey or vodka

ex.en: The store is not allowed to sell liquor to anyone under eighteen.
ex.zh: 這家店不得販賣酒類給未滿十八歲的人。

senses.en: lacking energy or interest

ex.en: The heat made everyone listless and irritable.
ex.zh: 炎熱讓每個人都無精打采又煩躁。

root.note: 沒有慾望的 → 無精打采

senses.en: the ability to read and write
knowledge or skill in a particular area

ex.en: Media literacy helps students recognize fake news.
ex.zh: 媒體素養能幫助學生辨識假新聞。

senses.en: taking words in their usual or most basic sense
(of a translation) word for word

ex.en: The literal meaning of "break a leg" is very different from its real meaning.
ex.zh: 「break a leg」的字面意思和它的真正含義相差很多。

senses.en: written works, especially those of lasting artistic value
the published writings on a particular subject

ex.en: She studied Chinese literature at National Taiwan University.
ex.zh: 她在台大研讀中國文學。

senses.en: thin, supple, and graceful

ex.en: The lithe gymnast bent backward until her hands touched the floor.
ex.zh: 那位身段柔軟的體操選手向後彎到雙手碰地。

senses.en: (literary) lithe; flexible and graceful

ex.en: The lithesome dancer seemed to float across the stage.
ex.zh: 那位身段輕盈的舞者彷彿在舞台上飄浮。

senses.en: a print made by lithography
to print by lithography

ex.en: The museum owns a rare lithograph by the famous poster artist.
ex.zh: 這間博物館收藏了一幅那位知名海報藝術家罕見的石版畫。

root.note: 在石頭上畫 → 石版畫

senses.en: an etched stone surface used for printing; a print made from it

ex.en: The old printer showed us a lithotype used to make maps a century ago.
ex.zh: 老印刷師讓我們看一塊百年前用來印地圖的石版。

senses.en: a person involved in a lawsuit

ex.en: Each litigant was given a chance to present evidence to the judge.
ex.zh: 每一方訴訟當事人都有機會向法官提出證據。

root.note: 推動訴訟的人 → 訴訟當事人

senses.en: to take a dispute to a court of law

ex.en: The two companies chose to litigate rather than settle privately.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司選擇打官司，而不是私下和解。

senses.en: too ready to go to court to settle disputes

ex.en: Doctors in a litigious society often order extra tests to protect themselves.
ex.zh: 在愛打官司的社會裡，醫生常會多做檢查來保護自己。

senses.en: relating to the shore of a sea or lake
a coastal region

ex.en: Many unique species live in the littoral zone between the tides.
ex.zh: 許多獨特物種生活在潮間帶的沿岸地區。

mn: 發音和 literal 很像，但意思完全不同。

senses.en: a fixed form of public worship used in a church

ex.en: The Easter liturgy includes special prayers and hymns.
ex.zh: 復活節禮拜儀式包含特別的禱告和聖詩。

root.note: 為公眾服務的工作 → 禮拜儀式

senses.en: a means of earning money to live

ex.en: The drought threatened the livelihood of thousands of farmers.
ex.zh: 這場乾旱威脅到數千名農民的生計。

senses.en: furiously angry
dark bluish-gray, like a bruise

ex.en: Dad was livid when he saw the dent in his new car.
ex.zh: 爸爸看到他新車上的凹痕時氣炸了。

senses.en: rich, fertile soil of clay, sand, and decayed plants

ex.en: Vegetables grow best in dark, crumbly loam.
ex.zh: 蔬菜在黑色鬆軟的壤土中長得最好。

senses.en: unwilling or reluctant to do something

ex.en: She was loath to leave her friends and move to another city.
ex.zh: 她很不願意離開朋友搬到另一個城市。

mn: loath（形容詞，不願意的，th 唸 [θ]）vs. loathe（動詞，厭惡，th 唸 [ð]）。

senses.en: to feel intense dislike or disgust for

ex.en: I loathe waiting in long lines at the bank.
ex.zh: 我非常討厭在銀行排長長的隊。

senses.en: (grammar) indicating place or location
the locative case

ex.en: Some languages use a locative ending to show where something is.
ex.zh: 有些語言用處所格詞尾來表示某物的位置。

senses.en: (Scottish) a lake or narrow arm of the sea

ex.en: Tourists hope to spot a monster in the famous Scottish loch.
ex.zh: 遊客們希望在那座著名的蘇格蘭湖泊裡看到水怪。

mn: 蘇格蘭人唸 [lɑx]，結尾是喉音；尼斯湖就是 Loch Ness。

senses.en: movement or the ability to move from one place to another

ex.en: Snakes rely on their muscles for locomotion since they have no legs.
ex.zh: 蛇沒有腳，所以靠肌肉來移動。

root.note: 從一個地方移動 → 移動能力

senses.en: a vein of metal ore in rock
a rich source of something

ex.en: The miners struck a rich lode of silver in the mountains.
ex.zh: 礦工們在山中挖到一條豐富的銀礦脈。

senses.en: the act of formally submitting something, such as a complaint
a secure position gained in enemy territory; a place to stay

ex.en: The troops secured a lodgment on the enemy's shore.
ex.zh: 部隊在敵方海岸上取得了一個據點。

root.note: 安置下來 → 據點；提交

senses.en: a way of reasoning; the study of correct reasoning
sensible reasons behind something

ex.en: I can't follow the logic of your argument.
ex.zh: 我無法理解你論點的邏輯。

root.note: 關於說理的學問 → 邏輯

senses.en: following the rules of logic; reasonable

ex.en: Given the evidence, the only logical conclusion is that he lied.
ex.zh: 根據證據，唯一合理的結論就是他說謊。

senses.en: a person who studies or is skilled in logic

ex.en: The logician pointed out a hidden flaw in the famous proof.
ex.zh: 那位邏輯學家指出那個著名證明中的隱藏漏洞。

senses.en: a person who stands or waits around idly without purpose

ex.en: The guard asked a loiterer outside the bank to move along.
ex.zh: 警衛請一名在銀行外逗留的人離開。

senses.en: sadness because one has no friends or company

ex.en: Many elderly people suffer from loneliness after their children move away.
ex.zh: 許多老人在子女搬走後飽受孤獨之苦。

senses.en: long life; the length of time something lasts

ex.en: Scientists are studying the diet of Okinawa to understand its residents' longevity.
ex.zh: 科學家研究沖繩的飲食，以了解當地居民長壽的原因。

senses.en: to steal goods, especially during a war or riot
goods stolen; (informal) money or valuables

ex.en: Rioters began to loot shops after the power went out.
ex.zh: 停電後，暴民開始洗劫商店。

senses.en: a minor or unimportant lord (often contemptuous)
senses.zh: 小貴族；小領主（常含輕蔑）

ex.en: The arrogant lordling demanded that the villagers bow to him.
ex.zh: 那個傲慢的小貴族要求村民向他鞠躬。

senses.en: (Irish) a lake or arm of the sea

ex.en: Fishing boats rested on the calm waters of the Irish lough.
ex.zh: 漁船停泊在平靜的愛爾蘭湖面上。

mn: 愛爾蘭拼法的 loch，當地唸 [lɑx]。

senses.en: a small insect that lives on the skin of people or animals (plural lice)
(informal) a contemptible person

ex.en: The nurse found a louse in the student's hair and sent a note home.
ex.zh: 護理師在那個學生頭髮裡發現一隻蝨子，便寫了通知單給家長。

senses.en: inspiring love or affection; easy to like

ex.en: The movie's lovable robot won the hearts of children everywhere.
ex.zh: 這部電影裡可愛的機器人擄獲了各地孩子的心。

senses.en: sad and depressed

ex.en: He felt low-spirited after failing his driving test again.
ex.zh: 他駕照考試又沒過，心情很低落。

senses.en: low in status or importance; humble

ex.en: He started as a lowly clerk and became the company's president.
ex.zh: 他從一個卑微的小職員做起，最後成為公司總裁。

senses.en: clearly expressed and easy to understand
able to think clearly, especially between periods of confusion

ex.en: The professor gave a lucid explanation of a very complex theory.
ex.zh: 教授把一個非常複雜的理論解釋得清楚明瞭。

root.note: 有光照亮的 → 清楚的

senses.en: producing a lot of money; profitable

ex.en: She left a lucrative job in banking to become a teacher.
ex.zh: 她放棄了銀行業的高薪工作去當老師。

mn: lucre 是「錢財」（常含貶義），filthy lucre 意為不義之財。

senses.en: so foolish or unreasonable that it is amusing

ex.en: It is ludicrous to charge twenty dollars for a bottle of water.
ex.zh: 一瓶水賣二十美元實在太荒唐了。

root.note: 像鬧劇一樣的 → 荒唐可笑

senses.en: a person who inspires others or is famous in a particular field

ex.en: The conference featured a luminary of modern physics as its keynote speaker.
ex.zh: 這場研討會邀請了一位現代物理學的泰斗擔任主講人。

root.note: 發光體 → 領域中耀眼的人物

senses.en: light given off by a substance without heat

ex.en: The luminescence of the jellyfish lit up the dark water.
ex.zh: 水母發出的冷光照亮了黑暗的海水。

senses.en: giving off light without heat

ex.en: The hikers marked the trail with luminescent paint.
ex.zh: 健行者用發光漆標示步道。

senses.en: the quality of giving off light; brightness

ex.en: Astronomers measured the luminosity of the distant star.
ex.zh: 天文學家測量了那顆遙遠恆星的亮度。

root.note: 充滿光的程度 → 亮度

senses.en: full of or giving off light; shining
very clear or brilliant

ex.en: The watch has luminous hands that glow in the dark.
ex.zh: 這支手錶的指針在黑暗中會發光。

senses.en: extreme foolishness
(dated) mental illness

ex.en: It would be sheer lunacy to drive in this snowstorm.
ex.zh: 在這種暴風雪中開車簡直是瘋了。

root.note: 古人認為月亮會使人發瘋 → 瘋狂

senses.en: relating to the moon

ex.en: Families gather to celebrate the Lunar New Year.
ex.zh: 家人們團聚慶祝農曆新年。

senses.en: (informal, offensive) a mentally ill person; a very foolish person
extremely foolish

ex.en: Only a lunatic would try to swim across the river in winter.
ex.zh: 只有瘋子才會想在冬天游過這條河。

root.note: 受月亮影響的人 → 瘋子

senses.en: a crescent-shaped figure formed by two intersecting arcs

ex.en: The geometry problem asked us to find the area of a lune.
ex.zh: 這道幾何題要我們求出一個新月形的面積。

senses.en: presented in a shocking or sensational way
unpleasantly bright in color

ex.en: The tabloid printed lurid details of the crime.
ex.zh: 那份小報刊登了這起罪行駭人聽聞的細節。

senses.en: having a rich, sweet taste or smell
very attractive; appealing to the senses

ex.en: The market sells luscious mangoes every summer.
ex.zh: 這個市場每年夏天都有香甜多汁的芒果。

senses.en: having a soft, glowing shine

ex.en: The horse had a lustrous black coat.
ex.zh: 那匹馬有一身光亮的黑色毛皮。

senses.en: rich and abundant growth

ex.en: Visitors were amazed by the luxuriance of the rainforest.
ex.zh: 遊客們對雨林的繁茂驚嘆不已。

senses.en: (of plants or hair) growing thickly and richly

ex.en: The garden was full of luxuriant ferns and flowers.
ex.zh: 花園裡長滿了茂盛的蕨類和花朵。

mn: luxuriant 是「茂盛的」，luxurious 才是「奢華的」。

senses.en: to relax and enjoy something pleasurable

ex.en: After the exam, I plan to luxuriate in a long hot bath.
ex.zh: 考完試後，我打算好好泡個長長的熱水澡。

senses.en: the act of telling lies
not telling the truth

ex.en: Lying to your friends will eventually destroy their trust.
ex.zh: 對朋友說謊終究會摧毀他們對你的信任。

mn: lie（說謊）與 lie（躺）的現在分詞都是 lying。

senses.en: a small U-shaped stringed instrument used in ancient Greece

ex.en: In the myth, Orpheus played the lyre so beautifully that rocks wept.
ex.zh: 在神話中，奧菲斯的里拉琴彈得如此動聽，連岩石都落淚。

mn: lyric（抒情詩、歌詞）就是源自「伴著 lyre 吟唱的詩」。

senses.en: (usually plural) the words of a song
(of poetry) expressing the writer's personal emotions
a short poem expressing personal feelings

ex.en: She wrote a lyric poem about her childhood home.
ex.zh: 她寫了一首關於兒時老家的抒情詩。

root.note: 伴著里拉琴吟唱的 → 抒情的；歌詞

senses.en: to pave a road with layers of crushed stone

ex.en: The town council voted to macadamize the muddy main street.
ex.zh: 鎮議會投票決定用碎石鋪設泥濘的主要街道。

parts.m: John McAdam 麥克亞當（蘇格蘭工程師）

root.note: 用麥克亞當發明的碎石法鋪路

senses.en: machines collectively, or the parts of a machine
the system or structure by which something operates

ex.en: The factory replaced its old machinery with robots.
ex.zh: 這家工廠用機器人取代了舊機械。

senses.en: a person who operates or repairs machine tools

ex.en: The machinist carefully cut the metal part to exact measurements.
ex.zh: 機械工小心地把金屬零件切割成精確的尺寸。

senses.en: the universe as a whole; a large complex system

ex.en: The novel shows a small village as a mirror of the macrocosm of society.
ex.zh: 這部小說把一個小村莊描寫成整個社會的縮影。

senses.en: to make someone very angry or annoyed

ex.en: The constant noise from the construction site would madden anyone.
ex.zh: 工地不斷傳來的噪音會讓任何人抓狂。

senses.en: the Virgin Mary; a picture or statue of her

ex.en: The chapel contains a Renaissance painting of the Madonna and Child.
ex.zh: 這座小禮拜堂收藏了一幅文藝復興時期的聖母子像。
